catalogue.name: Claude Code
catalogue.description: Anthropic's Claude Code CLI, driven in stream-json mode through mfw's compatibility server.

auth.hint: Run `claude` once and sign in, or `claude setup-token`. A Claude subscription needs no API key: this is how most operators run mfw.
Pay-per-token instead of a subscription. NOTE: mfw does not yet inject a stored key into the agent's environment: export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for the server until it does.

catalogue.name: OpenAI Codex CLI
catalogue.description: OpenAI's Codex CLI, driven through its app-server protocol with structured lifecycle events, steering, interruption and approvals.

auth.hint: Sign in through the Codex CLI itself.

catalogue.name: Gemini CLI
catalogue.description: Google's Gemini CLI, driven over the Agent Client Protocol (`gemini --acp`). Runs tasks, project-brain turns (read-only plan mode) and critic calls; no custom endpoints.

auth.hint: Set GEMINI_API_KEY, or sign in through the Gemini CLI.

catalogue.name: Cursor Agent
catalogue.description: Cursor's agent CLI, driven over the Agent Client Protocol (`agent acp`). Runs tasks, project-brain turns (read-only plan mode) and critic calls; no custom endpoints.

identity.describe: Cursor's CLI (installed as a link to .../cursor-agent)

auth.hint: Sign in through the Cursor agent CLI itself.
Export CURSOR_API_KEY for the server instead of signing in.

catalogue.name: opencode
catalogue.description: opencode, driven over the Agent Client Protocol (`opencode acp`). Runs tasks, project-brain turns and critic calls with permissions denied for edits and shell; can use an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

auth.hint: Configure a provider inside opencode itself.

catalogue.name: pi
catalogue.description: The pi coding agent, driven over the Agent Client Protocol through pi-acp (an MVP adapter; needs pi >= 0.81 and Node >= 22). Runs tasks, project-brain turns and critic calls; can use an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Models are `provider/id` from your own pi configuration.

identity.describe: the pi coding agent (`pi --help` names it)

auth.hint: Configure a provider in pi itself: `pi auth login <provider>`, or add one to ~/.pi/agent/models.json.

hostProbeScript:
set -u
lp=$(sh -lc 'printf "
MFW_LOGIN_PATH=%s
" "$PATH"' </dev/null 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^MFW_LOGIN_PATH=//p' | tail -n1)
if [ -n "$lp" ]; then PATH="$lp:$PATH"; fi
PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"
export PATH
printf '%s
' MFW_HOST_PROBE_V1
printf 'uid=%s
' "$(id -u)"
printf 'user=%s
' "$(id -un)"
printf 'home=%s
' "$HOME"
printf 'path=%s
' "$PATH"
if sudo -n true >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo sudo=allowed; else echo sudo=refused; fi
printf 'bwrap.path=%s
' "$(command -v bwrap || true)"
if command -v bwrap >/dev/null 2>&1 && bwrap --die-with-parent --ro-bind / / --dev /dev --proc /proc true >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo bwrap=yes; else echo bwrap=no; fi
printf 'setsid=%s
' "$(command -v setsid || true)"
printf 'bun=%s
' "$(command -v bun || true)"
printf 'git=%s
' "$(command -v git || true)"
if command -v claude >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'harness.claude-cli=%s
' "$(claude --version 2>/dev/null | head -n1 | tr -d '')"; else printf 'harness.claude-cli=
'; fi
a=no; for f in "$HOME"/'.claude/.credentials.json'; do [ -s "$f" ] && a=yes; done; printf 'auth.claude-cli=%s
' "$a"
if command -v codex >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'harness.codex-cli=%s
' "$(codex --version 2>/dev/null | head -n1 | tr -d '')"; else printf 'harness.codex-cli=
'; fi
a=no; for f in "$HOME"/'.codex/auth.json'; do [ -s "$f" ] && a=yes; done; printf 'auth.codex-cli=%s
' "$a"
if command -v agent >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ "$(basename "$(readlink -f "$(command -v agent)")")" = 'cursor-agent' ]; then printf 'harness.cursor-agent=%s
' "$(agent --version 2>/dev/null | head -n1 | tr -d '')"; else printf 'harness.cursor-agent=
'; fi
a=no; for f in "$HOME"/'.cursor/cli-config.json'; do [ -s "$f" ] && a=yes; done; printf 'auth.cursor-agent=%s
' "$a"
if command -v gemini >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'harness.gemini-cli=%s
' "$(gemini --version 2>/dev/null | head -n1 | tr -d '')"; else printf 'harness.gemini-cli=
'; fi
a=no; for f in "$HOME"/'.gemini/oauth_creds.json'; do [ -s "$f" ] && a=yes; done; printf 'auth.gemini-cli=%s
' "$a"
if command -v opencode >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'harness.opencode=%s
' "$(opencode --version 2>/dev/null | head -n1 | tr -d '')"; else printf 'harness.opencode=
'; fi
a=no; for f in "$HOME"/'.local/share/opencode/auth.json'; do [ -s "$f" ] && a=yes; done; printf 'auth.opencode=%s
' "$a"
if command -v pi >/dev/null 2>&1 && pi '--help' 2>/dev/null | grep -Eiq '^pi.*coding (assistant|agent)'; then printf 'harness.pi=%s
' "$(pi --version 2>/dev/null | head -n1 | tr -d '')"; else printf 'harness.pi=
'; fi
a=no; for f in "$HOME"/'.pi/agent/auth.json' "$HOME"/'.pi/agent/models.json'; do [ -s "$f" ] && a=yes; done; printf 'auth.pi=%s
' "$a"
printf 'gpus=%s
' "$( (nvidia-smi -L 2>/dev/null || true) | grep -c '^GPU' )"
printf 'disk.kib=%s
' "$(df -Pk "$HOME" 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==2{print $4}')"
printf 'mem.kib=%s
' "$(awk '/^MemAvailable:/{print $2}' /proc/meminfo 2>/dev/null)"
